edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the transfer source.
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender when reducing allowance.
transferFrom delegates the balance update to _transfer.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorizes the caller against the development or marketing address.
manualsend authorizes the caller against the development or marketing address.
_transfer triggers an external router swap while transfer state is still being processed.
_transfer sends ETH out to the marketing address during the transfer flow.
swapTokensForEth performs an external swap call that can re-enter before state settles.
sendETHToFee forwards the amount into the native ETH transfer.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the deadline argument of the router call.
_transfer eventually invokes _tokenTransfer to move balances.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard after optional fee removal.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from the sender reflection balance.
The subtraction result is written back into the _rOwned mapping.
_getTValues multiplies and divides to derive fee amounts.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from the reflection total.
The reduced value is stored back into _rTotal.
_getRate divides reflection supply by token supply.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues obtains token values from _getTValues.
_getValues obtains reflection values from _getRValues.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
